_comment_baseline_format: Regression-tracking sidecar to the absolute thresholds: runAll.mjs warns (still PASS) when a metric drifts > 20% the bad way from tests/load/baselines.json. That file is local and per machine (gitignored); copy this one and put in your machine's numbers.
_comment_how_to_update: On a quiet machine with the dev stack up: `just load > /tmp/load.json`, then copy each scenario's figures into baselines.json. Keys: latency_avg_ms / latency_p95_ms (latency.*), ops_per_sec and doc_size_bytes_after_run (hotEdit), events_per_sec (awarenessFlood rate_per_sec), initial_sync_ms (docGrowth sync.avg_ms), doc_size_bytes (docGrowth encoded_size_bytes).
_comment_values: MacBook, 2026-10-15, the worse of two runs (tests/load/README.md → Baselines): the millisecond latencies spread 30-40% between runs.
_comment_tolerance: Default ±20% drift allowed silently; `_toleranceFactor` on a scenario overrides it for that scenario's metrics.
